universal_scope: Every arbitrary-size P7-free seeded-precoloring state satisfying the exact PATH_CELL hypotheses below.

roles.T: old source type of competing survivor v and stored p
roles.T_prime: old source type of selected L2 vertex x, stored n, and paired survivor y_prime
roles.p: stored P endpoint of exact 111 state
roles.m: stored M support vertex of exact 111 state
roles.n: stored N endpoint of exact 111 state
roles.s: an old-seed vertex in T_prime; because x,n have exact type T_prime, sx and sn are edges
roles.x: selected L0 vertex; exact type T_prime; exact 3-list L(x)=L(y_prime); selected branch color alpha=f'(p)
roles.v: competing C11 survivor of exact type T; exact 3-list L(v)=L(y); alpha belongs to L(v)
roles.z: residual Y0 witness adjacent to v after x is added to the L2 seed

PATH_CELL_hypotheses: T and T_prime have distinct singleton seed colors, hence T intersect T_prime is empty.
The exact 111 state has P={p}, M={m}, N={n}, with pm and mn edges and pn nonedge.
p has old type T; n has old type T_prime; v has old type T; x has old type T_prime.
C11 survivor authority gives p and n nonadjacent to v; source orientation gives mv nonedge.
C11 crossed-list authority gives f'(p),f'(n) in L(v) intersect L(y_prime), and f'(m) in L(v)\L(y_prime).
x is chosen from the paired survivor list class: L(x)=L(y_prime), so f'(p),f'(n) are in L(x) and f'(m) is not in L(x).
The L2 branch selects x with color alpha=f'(p).
The class-elimination side assumes xv is an edge.
z is in residual Y0 after x is seeded and vz is an edge.

consecutive_edges: n has exact old type T_prime and s in T_prime
x has exact old type T_prime and s in T_prime

nonconsecutive_pair_audit.reason: p has exact type T and s is in disjoint T_prime
f'(p) is in exact 3-list L(x); p is already seeded with f'(p)
z is residual Y0 and p is in enlarged seed
m is original Y0 and s is old seed
f'(m) is the unique color in L(v)\L(x), hence f'(m) is already absent from L(x)
source orientation f'(m) in L(v) while m is seeded
z is residual Y0 and m is in enlarged seed
f'(n) is in exact 3-list L(x); n is already seeded with f'(n)
z is residual Y0 and n is in enlarged seed
v has exact type T and s is in disjoint T_prime
z is residual Y0 and s is in seed
z remains residual Y0 after x is added to seed

theorem_target.chord_exhaustion: Among nonconsecutive pairs of p-m-n-s-x-v-z, the only pair not forced nonadjacent is x-m.
theorem_target.P7_consequence: Because G is P7-free and all six path edges are present, xm must be an edge.
theorem_target.safe_support: xm is list-safe for x because f'(m) is already absent from exact L(x)=L(y_prime); recognizing the existing edge does not further shrink x's list.

explicit_limitations: Does not prove that every L2 class-elimination edge x-v lies in PATH_CELL.
Does not prove that equal list classes imply equal source types.
Does not modify the input graph.
Does not repair the xv=0 survivor side.
Does not establish a general support implication grammar.
